text:
The starved ring cannot reach a tuning ratio of 29 with the starvers driven straight from vctrl. At 0.7 V they are still well on, so f_lo stays near 600 MHz, and the high end is capped by the inverters. A refine cannot fix this, because the sensitivities show a trade-off with f_mid. The edit below adds a resistive divider so the starvers see a lower gate voltage.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Starvers are strongly on at 0.7 V, so f_lo cannot drop below f_hi/29. Add a resistive divider (vctrl to vcn) to shift the starver gate drive. At 0.7 V the starvers then sit near cutoff and f_lo is set by Rfl. Wide starvers keep mid/high near the inverter-limited ceiling. Model recalibrated."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wn_inv": (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),    # ring inverter NMOS width (L=0.15)
    "Wp_inv": (1.2, 0.42, 4.0),    # ring inverter PMOS width (L=0.15)
    "Ws_n":   (5.0, 1.0, 16.0),    # NMOS starving device width
    "Ws_p":   (12.0, 2.0, 40.0),   # PMOS starving device width
    "Ls":     (0.2, 0.15, 0.6),    # starving/mirror channel length
    "kref":   (6.0, 2.0, 12.0),    # starver/reference mirror ratio
    "Wbuf":   (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),     # final buffer NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Rfl":    (150e3, 30e3, 1e6),  # floor resistor across each starver (sets f_lo)
    "adiv":   (0.75, 0.55, 0.95),  # divider ratio vcn = adiv*vctrl
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 3
    Li = 0.15
    Wn, Wp = p["Wn_inv"], p["Wp_inv"]
    Wsn, Wsp, Ls, k = p["Ws_n"], p["Ws_p"], p["Ls"], p["kref"]
    Wb = p["Wbuf"]
    Rfl = p["Rfl"]
    a = p["adiv"]
    Rd = 200e3
    Wrn, Wrp = max(0.42, Wsn / k), max(0.42, Wsp / k)
    k_eff_p = Wsp / Wrp

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # control level-shift divider (gate-only load) + decoupling
    n.R("RD1", "vctrl", "vcn", Rd * (1 - a))
    n.R("RD2", "vcn", "vss", Rd * a)
    n.C("CDN", "vcn", "vss", 2e-12)
    # reference branch: NMOS on vcn -> diode PMOS generates vbp
    n.M("MRN", "vbp", "vcn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wrn, Ls)
    n.M("MRP", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wrp, Ls)
    n.C("CDP", "vbp", "vdd", 1e-12)
    for i in range(N):
        ai, y = f"x{i}", f"x{(i + 1) % N}"
        n.M(f"MSP{i}", f"pa{i}", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wsp, Ls)
        n.R(f"RFP{i}", "vdd", f"pa{i}", Rfl)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, ai, f"pa{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, ai, f"na{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.M(f"MSN{i}", f"na{i}", "vcn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wsn, Ls)
        n.R(f"RFN{i}", f"na{i}", "vss", Rfl)
    Wb1 = max(0.42, Wb / 3)
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "x0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wb1, Li)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "x0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb1, Li)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wb, Li)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Li)

    def cg(dev, W, L):
        try:
            return abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"])
        except Exception:
            return 1.5e-15 * W
    c_gate = cg("n", Wn, Li) + cg("p", Wp, Li)
    c_drain = 0.6 * c_gate + 0.09 * (cg("n", Wsn, Ls) + cg("p", Wsp, Ls))
    C = c_gate + c_drain + 1e-15
    C0 = C + cg("n", Wb1, Li) + cg("p", 2 * Wb1, Li)
    Cavg = (2 * C + C0) / 3
    KCAL = 1.0

    I_floor = 0.35 / Rfl

    def istarve(vc):
        vg = a * vc
        In = abs(lut.op("n", Wsn, Ls, vg, 0.6)["Id"])
        Iref = abs(lut.op("n", Wrn, Ls, vg, 0.6)["Id"])
        Ip = Iref * k_eff_p
        return min(In, Ip) + I_floor, Iref

    Iinv = min(abs(lut.op("n", Wn, Li, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"]),
               abs(lut.op("p", Wp, Li, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"]))
    f_ceil = KCAL * Iinv / (N * Cavg * VDD)

    fs, irefs = [], []
    for vc in (0.7, 1.05, 1.4):
        I, Ir = istarve(vc)
        f_st = KCAL * I / (N * Cavg * VDD)
        fs.append(1.0 / (1.0 / f_st + 1.0 / f_ceil))
        irefs.append(Ir)
    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = fs

    Cb = cg("n", Wb, Li) + cg("p", 2 * Wb, Li)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15) if isinstance(spec, dict) else 10e-15
    p_ring = N * Cavg * VDD**2 * f_mid
    p_buf = (Cb * 1.6 + CL + 3 * cg("n", Wb, Li)) * VDD**2 * f_mid
    p_ref = irefs[1] * VDD
    p_floor = 2 * N * I_floor * 0.5 * VDD * 0.3
    power = 0.7 * (p_ring + p_buf) + p_ref + p_floor

    return n, {
        "f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / 0.7,
        "swing": 1.6,
        "power": power,
    }
```
